intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan.

lines.opening: Hello, this is Kestrel Mutual's digital assistant, and we record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am Kestrel Mutual's digital assistant.
lines.scam: This is a genuine call from Kestrel Mutual, and you can check by calling us on the number on our website.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details on this call.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, it will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, between 9:30 in the morning and 6:30 in the evening, today or on the next business day?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back today or on the next business day, between 9:30 in the morning and 6:30 in the evening. Could you suggest another time?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, we will update our records.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: These questions make sure I only speak with the right person.
lines.id_explain: We ask them to protect your personal information.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I can't continue this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't confirm your identity, so I can't continue. Please use the Kestrel Mutual app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling about overdue payments on your Kestrel Mutual accounts.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} overdue, and it is {days} days overdue.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay all the overdue amounts in full today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, the lowest amount I can accept is {floor}.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the payment date must be today or later.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day, so the payment date would be {date}.
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day could you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: To repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the date you named is after the latest date allowed, so it will be {date}.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise for your {name} could not be saved.
lines.paid_line: Thank you, payments can take one business day to show.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, and I won't discuss that account further on this call.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like me to transfer you to our wellbeing team, who can help?
lines.restructure_line: I'll connect you with our arrangements team, who can discuss a payment plan.
lines.human_ask_help: Can I help you with anything before I transfer you?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now, please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, a promise that is already saved can't be changed on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.

assumptions: Holidays: P9's list (2026-11-19, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28, 2027-01-01) plus 2026-12-07 from M2.3. 2026-12-24 is left out: M1.2 made it a holiday, but M2.1 withdrew that and made it a normal business day.

M1.2 was only in force from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31. A call in that period can't reach a promise or callback date of 2026-12-24, so leaving that date out changes nothing. M2.3 (2026-12-07) is in force from 2026-11-01, and no earlier call's deadline reaches that date.

M1.1 (which M2.2 keeps): overdrafts in the late band (11-60 days) have a deadline of the 3rd business day after today. Cards and loans in the late band keep the 6th business day, and every early-band account keeps the 10th. M1.1 is in force from 2026-10-01; calls are assumed to be on or after that date.
Callbacks are on business days only, because M2.3 says 2026-12-07 is not a business day for callbacks. This means 'today' only counts if today is a business day.
Callback max_asks = 2: after the first time outside the window, ask once more, then close as no_callback.
Identity answers: dob is sent as DD/MM/YYYY (%d/%m/%Y), so date_order is dmy. Postcode is sent in capitals with no spaces. No fixed length is given because UK postcodes vary in length.
The verify tool returns no hint field, so hints is empty and the hint response field is blank. A rejected unreadable value comes back with ok=false and does not count as a wrong answer.
get_account amounts are in pounds and create_promise takes amount_pence, so promise_scale is 100. The brief gives no rounding rule, so promise_round is null.
Floors: card min_due, loan repayment, overdraft excess. M1.1 says the overdraft floor does not change. The spoken floor names are my own wording, because the brief only gives field names.
The opening ask (all accounts in full today) is not counted as a persuasion attempt (P15/P16). Only a flat refusal on an account uses an attempt. Early band: 1 attempt. Late band: 2 attempts.

Ladder: attempt 1 is the full arrears on the last business day of this week, or next week's if today is that day (week_end_today = next_week). It is capped at the account's deadline if later. Attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.
deadline_adjust = next_business_day, because P11 moves a weekend day or holiday the customer names to the next business day. The computed deadlines are already business days.

The brief doesn't say what happens when the customer says the full amount is too much before any attempt. I used the default too_much_floor = attempt_1. Below the floor, the floor is offered once (P14).
date_rules.next_weekday and max_not_talk use the defaults, because the brief is silent on both.
P3 says the opening must say the call is recorded. The opening says 'we record this call'.
P19: on any transfer, no notes are written. The service_error outcome has no note (P23).
Paid and disputed accounts don't stop the call; the agent goes on to the next account (P20).
No line about text messages or changing a promise is prescribed. sms_line is empty, and promise_change says the promise can't be changed on this call.
Days overdue outside 1-60: the brief gives no rule, so bands_outside is null.
All amounts and dates come from the brief and tool API. The prompt's example values (such as 12 business days and the 10:00-19:00 callback window) were not used.
